### Chimera Logical Anomaly Detection

A neuro-symbolic anomaly detector that learns to evaluate logical constraints without requiring real rule-violating anomalies during training.

[Repository →](https://github.com/aleazk/chimera-logical-anomaly-detection){.card-link}

### Hyperspherical-Compressed VAE

A variational autoencoder that reduces high-dimensional latent sparsity through hyperspherical-coordinate regularisation for anomaly and out-of-distribution detection.

[Repository →](https://github.com/aleazk/cond-ad-hyperspherical-compressed-vae){.card-link}
